The '''20th Producers Guild of America Awards''' (also known as '''2009 Producers Guild Awards'''), honoring the best [[Film producer|film]] and [[television producer]]s of 2008, were held at [[Hollywood Palladium]] in [[Hollywood, California]] on January 24, 2009.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Siegel|first1=Tatiana|title=‘Slumdog’ is top dog at PGAs|url=https://variety.com/2009/film/awards/slumdog-is-top-dog-at-pgas-1117999029/|accessdate=September 21, 2017|work=Variety|date=January 24, 2009|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170922002710/http://variety.com/2009/film/awards/slumdog-is-top-dog-at-pgas-1117999029/|archivedate=September 22, 2017|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Kilday |first1=Gregg |last2=Zeitchik |first2=Steven |title='Slumdog' fetches PGA prize |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/slumdog-fetches-pga-prize-78194 |accessdate=April 3, 2020 |work=The Hollywood Reporter |date=January 26, 2009}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=2009 PGA Award Winners - Producers Guild of America|url=http://www.producersguild.org/page/2009award_winners|website=www.producersguild.org|accessdate=August 27, 2017|archive-date=August 21, 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170821084836/http://www.producersguild.org/page/2009award_winners|url-status=dead}}</ref> The nominations were announced on December 10, 2008, and January 5, 2009.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Fernandez |first1=Jay |title=Producers guild unveils nominations |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/producers-guild-unveils-nominations-77126 |accessdate=April 3, 2020 |work=The Hollywood Reporter |date=January 5, 2009}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=McNary|first1=Dave|title=PGA announces TV nominees|url=https://variety.com/2008/film/awards/pga-announces-tv-nominees-1117997169/|accessdate=September 21, 2017|work=Variety|date=December 10, 2008|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170922002506/http://variety.com/2008/film/awards/pga-announces-tv-nominees-1117997169/|archivedate=September 22, 2017|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=McNary|first1=Dave|title=PGA unveils film nominations|url=https://variety.com/2009/film/awards/pga-unveils-film-nominations-2-1117997946/|accessdate=September 21, 2017|work=Variety|date=January 5, 2009|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170830054448/http://variety.com/2009/film/awards/pga-unveils-film-nominations-2-1117997946/|archivedate=August 30, 2017|url-status=live}}</ref>
